messages:
Sam (Product): Heads-up — enterprise EU customer asking for an onramp where they can guarantee data residency + 50ms p50 frontend routing. They want options and launch criteria. Proposing three initiative paths: Isolation-first, Affinity-first, Hybrid. Thoughts?

Nina (Infra): Thanks. quick notes: Isolation-first = dedicated pools by tenant/region (higher cost, simpler SLA). Affinity-first = best-effort region affinity + fallbacks (cheaper, more complex routing). Hybrid = dedicated for top customers, affinity for rest.

Luis (Architecture): +1 to explicit criteria. We should map each path to gating metrics: p50/p99, cross-region failover time, onboarding effort. Also call out rollout complexity & bookkeeping (model variants + routing templates).

Priya (SRE): From ops POV: we need the runbook and automatic fallback policy for all options. Required launch criteria: canary traffic with 0 customer-facing errors for 48h, automated throttles, and observable rollback path. Otherwise we end up firefighting.

Jesse (Sales): Customer will pay for dedicated if we can commit to isolation SLAs. They asked for dedicated vpc + audit logs. If we present hybrid as staged option they’ll likely pick dedicated for first 6 months. Pricing lead time needed.

Ava (Customer Success): Customer acceptance tests: synthetic latencies from EU edge -> model endpoint, data residency proof, and audit log export. We should include that in the launch checklist.

Sam (Product): Good — can we sketch quick decision tradeoff table? I sketched this in the thread:

- Isolation-first: Pros: deterministic latency, simple tenancy isolation, aligns with enterprise asks. Cons: cost, longer provisioning time. Gating: dedicated pool autoscale tested, KMS/HSM integrated, audit logs validated.
- Affinity-first: Pros: lower cost, faster onboarding. Cons: weaker isolation guarantees, more complex traffic shaping & risk of noisy neighbors. Gating: affinity policies, fallback window <300ms added latency, telemetry for misrouted requests.
- Hybrid: Pros: pragmatic commercial path. Cons: two-path complexity + docs. Gating: all Isolation gating for dedicated customers + affinity rollout for others.

Luis (Architecture): Add a small sample routing policy pseudo-config so infra can estimate effort:

```
route {
  match: region == "eu" && tenant_tier == "enterprise" => prefer(dedicated_pool_eu)
  else => prefer(affinity_pool_closest)
  fallback => prefer(default_shared_pool)
}
```

Nina (Infra): That helps. Dev effort rough estimate: Isolation-first ~6 weeks infra + 4 weeks runbooks + capacity commit; Affinity-first ~3 weeks infra + 2 weeks telemetry; Hybrid ~8-10 weeks including billing & onboarding flows. All estimates assume we reuse existing autoscaler and KV cache sharding.

Priya (SRE): Acceptance criteria we should list in product ticket:
- 99.9% availability during canary
- No p99 latency regressions > 200ms compared to baseline for dedicated pool
- Successful audit log exports for a stretched week
- Defined eviction threshold & mitigation steps for noisy tenants

Sam (Product): Proposed prioritization: 1) Hybrid MVP for a single EU region targeting top 5 enterprise customers (fastest revenue path), 2) Affinity improvements for cost optimization, 3) Full Isolation for wide rollout when demand justifies. Decision needed by EOD Friday to align budget.

Jesse (Sales): I can commit to lining up customer pilots if we can promise the hybrid MVP timeline. Sales needs feature cut and a one-pager to take to legal/security.

Ava (Customer Success): I’ll draft the acceptance test plan for pilot customers and collect required data points (latency, logs, KMS attestations).

Luis (Architecture): One open technical risk: model-aware routing — we'll need compatibility mapping between model variants when we fallback. Need to confirm QA for output parity. Recommend a separate spike for model-variant compatibility.

Sam (Product): Action items:
- Nina: get infra rough estimates into the RFC by Wed (Nina: ack?)
- Luis: spike for model-variant compatibility (2w)
- Priya: draft SRE launch checklist and rollback policy
- Jesse/Ava: gather 1-2 customers willing to pilot hybrid MVP

Nina (Infra): ack — will drop estimates and a short ops checklist into RFC by Wed.

Priya (SRE): ack, starting checklist doc, will include canary windows + metric alerts.

routing-bot: Reminder: runbook template created at /playbooks/routing-onramp.md (automated). :bell:

Sam (Product): Thanks everyone. Will consolidate into an RFC and scope the product ticket. If no objections I’ll lock prioritization on Friday. :thumbsup:
